description: This file defines various UI components for a React-based application, including popovers, modals, lists, buttons, icons, and utility functions for dialogs such as confirm, prompt, and toast notifications. It serves as a UI library component collection used throughout the project.

methods.name: Popover
methods.description: A React functional component rendering a popover with overlay mask and content.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: A container component for grouping child elements with optional styling.

methods.name: ListItem
methods.description: A component representing an item within a list, with optional icon, subtitle, and click handler.

methods.name: List
methods.description: A component rendering a list container for child nodes.

methods.name: Loading
methods.description: A component showing a full-page loading spinner.

methods.name: Modal
methods.description: A comprehensive modal dialog component supporting title, content, actions, and max/min toggling.

methods.name: showModal
methods.description: Programmatically renders a modal dialog into the DOM.

methods.name: Toast
methods.description: A notification component for displaying transient messages.

methods.name: showToast
methods.description: Displays a toast message with optional action and auto-dismiss.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: A textarea component with auto-height and other HTML props.

methods.name: PasswordInput
methods.description: A password input with toggle visibility feature.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: A styled select dropdown component with icon.

methods.name: showConfirm
methods.description: Programmatically shows a confirmation dialog, resolving to true/false based on user choice.

methods.name: showPrompt
methods.description: Shows a prompt dialog for user input, returning the entered string.

methods.name: showImageModal
methods.description: Displays an image in a modal for preview.

methods.name: Selector
methods.description: A selection component for choosing one item from a list.
